rmsId.description: Identity used to track jobs originated from command-line

startTime.description: Approximate start time of the job. e.g. within 10 min

workDir.description: The path to the working directory of this job, when the job originates from command-line

_project.description: Subset of the full information about the project that this job belongs to.

_material.description: Subset of the full information about the materials used inside this job.

_materials.description: Subset of the full information about the materials used inside a multi-material job.

_materialsSet.description: Subset of the full information about the materials set used inside a multi-material job.

parent.description: Subset of the full information about the parent job for the job. Only a job from the same project can be assigned as a parent one.

runtimeContext.description: Context variables that the job will have access to at runtime

scopeTrack.description: history of the workflow scope on each update

dataset.description: Dataset configuration for a data-driven job

isExternal.description: Whether the job was submitted from outside the RMS (e.g. via the REST API) - determines which cloud storage bucket its files are read from/written to.
